sloka: ततो ऽङ्गदं परिक्षिप्तं त्रिभिर्नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवैः।हनुमानपि विज्ञाय नीलश्चापि प्रतस्थतुः ।। ६.७०.२० ।।
transliteration: tato 'ṅgadaṁ parikṣiptaṁ tribhirnairṛtapuṅgavaiḥ।hanumānapi vijñāya nīlaścāpi pratasthatuḥ ।। 6.70.20 ।।

translations.english: Then finding Angada surrounded by the three Rakshasa leaders, Hanuman as well as Neela set out.
